# dsh-studio-library

[简体中文](README.zh.md)

## Repository

- Repository name: `dsh-studio-library`
- Repository description: Installable DSH control bundle for studio discovery, project containers, service status, sessions and updates. Business studios remain optional.
- Source: `https://github.com/1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-library`

## Features

- `dsh-worktable`: studio list, control room, project container, split workspace and window layout.
- `dsh-studio-projects`: studio registration, page serving, local-service startup and health status, session tools, task expansion and update records.
- Project data and update records are isolated under `DSH_HOME/studio/<studio-id>/`.
- The root package bundles only the two control packages. It does not install business studios or private Live2D/Cubism assets.
- The root manifest declares `dsh.bundle.patch`; `packages/worktable` and `packages/runtime` retain their own package manifests and compiled Host/Client entries.

## Installation

Use the official Desktop plugin manager after fully quitting Desktop, or run the bundled carrier at `resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh.cmd` on Windows. Install the control bundle and then only the business studios you need:

```powershell
& "<Desktop install directory>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add "github:1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-library#v0.1.13"
& "<Desktop install directory>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop list
```

The first command installs `dsh-worktable` and `dsh-studio-projects`; an empty business-studio list is valid. Add a studio from its own README. Verify the installed package with `plugin --profile desktop list`; the manifest must contain `dsh.bundle.patch`, and the package must expose its declared `main` entry and patch file. Restart Desktop after package operations.

Git commits do not update an installed lockfile. Reinstall the exact tag when upgrading. Keep `DSH_HOME/studio/` before removing an older combined package, and install any business studios you want to keep before removing that package.

## Requirements and limits

Use DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` compatible builds and Node.js 22 for source builds. Local applications, OBS, external providers and model assets require their own setup. The public package contains no credentials, private model files or Cubism Core.

## License and sources

The project is MIT licensed. The worktable adaptation retains the upstream notices documented in `SDK-SNAPSHOT.json` and the repository files.

# 工作库共享运行时

提供所有者认证、插件资源登记与 Toonflow 共享会话。业务页面由各工作室独立拥有；通过 studioProjects.register 登记，卸载撤销新请求。构建：`node scripts/build.mjs runtime`。

向普通新会话提供 `studio` 工具：列举、打开、读取、点击、填写、选择和滚动。命令通过所有者认证的内存队列交给主窗口，结果来自实际页面；取消、超时与插件停用会撤销待执行命令。接入规范见 `packages/sdk/CONTROL.md`。

## 本机服务自动启动

Windows 开发入口在 profile 的 `dsh-studio-projects.config.autoStartServices` 写入启动组；普通桌面加载共享运行时也会执行。每组指定 `label`、`studioIds`、程序 `command`、参数 `args`、工作目录 `cwd`、日志 `logFile` 和正整数 `timeoutMs`；程序、目录和日志使用绝对路径。短剧和影视复用 Harness 的 `scripts/studio-apps.ps1`，影音使用工作库的 `scripts/start-cineflow.ps1`。已有服务按原启动器的身份记录复用。

连接接口等待启动脚本结束，再检查真实健康状态；启动失败在对应工作室显示原因和日志路径，其他页面仍可使用。插件停用或退出桌面只取消尚在执行的启动脚本，不停止已经运行的独立服务。清空 `autoStartServices` 可关闭自动启动；`DSH_STUDIO_SKIP_APPS=1` 可临时跳过。首次配置的原文备份为 `cordis.patch.yml.before-studio-startup`。

## 版本与更新

在工作室公共工具栏选择“版本与更新”，查看已登记工作室的插件版本，检查各自 GitHub 正式发布，并通过 dsh 插件管理器安装适配包。发布页必须同时提供安装包与 schemaVersion 1 的 manifest.json；每个 artifacts 条目包含 name、version、file、sha256、dsh 和可选 dshVersions。检查只接受插件 package.json 的 GitHub repository，不使用原应用安装器。尚未发布、网络失败和不兼容分别显示；安装前核对摘要及包内名称和版本。

更新记录及安装包保存在 DSH_HOME/studio/updates；安装不清空账号、历史、配置或媒体。关闭面板不会中断安装，提示需要重启时完整退出并重新打开 dsh。中断后无法确认的结果显示为未知，重启后核对插件版本。profile 的 updates 支持 timeoutMs、downloadTimeoutMs、maxPackageBytes、directory，分别控制检查超时、下载超时、安装包大小上限及绝对更新目录。

旧安装包缺少 repository 时，可在 profile 的 `updates.repositories` 按插件包名配置 `owner/repository`，例如 `dsh-studio-media: 1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-media`；此配置优先于安装包声明。它只选择受控的插件发布仓库，不接受下载 URL。损坏的更新记录只暂停升级，工作室其他功能仍可使用。

# 本仓库工作室适配

当前插件拆分、模型切换与上游接入方式见 [独立工作室开发规范](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)。

此目录是基于 dsh-worktable 0.4.0 的 0.6.0 独立适配包，目标 Harness 为 0.2.1-rc.2。
工作室位于“更多”上方，默认折叠，展开高度 15rem（最大 40vh），超出滚动且隐藏滚动条。
项目打开后默认隐藏聊天并占满内容区，可用顶部“显示聊天”切回分屏，按项目记住选择；退出、禁用或重新锚定时恢复宿主可见性、焦点可达状态与布局，不清除草稿。单窗只保留一层标题，单标签不显示标签栏，多标签仍可切换。首次展开后保留分屏和控制室的状态桥；禁用插件释放路由、连接、观察器和全局桥，保留项目数据。
本适配源码在共享库根目录运行 npm run build 构建，安装包由 npm run pack 生成；网页端可用 dsh plugin --profile web add <本适配 tgz 的绝对路径> 独立安装。桌面安装使用应用自带 CLI carrier，完整退出后执行 plugin --profile desktop add <本地包绝对路径>，然后重新打开。详细说明见 [共享库 README](../../README.md)。下文保留上游版本历史，其中的旧兼容范围和远程发布包不代表本适配的验证范围。

短剧工作台保留自己的聊天界面，通过受控桥接使用绑定的 dsh 会话，同步消息、流式回复、工具结果、模型与运行状态，停止按钮取消同一任务。绑定和发送不自动展开主聊天。配套共享运行时 0.5.0 和各工作室 0.2.0 与 Toonflow 完整补丁；关闭或切换项目释放视图订阅，后台任务继续运行。

---

# dsh-worktable（工作台）

> DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的 agent 级项目容器（应用抽屉）。纯增量插件，不替换、不禁用任何官方插件。

## 是什么

- **侧边栏「工作台」区块**：收纳已安装工作室，支持改名/图标/排序/显示隐藏和项目 × 对话绑定；新增入口发起 AI 新增工作室流程，不提供布局或项目文件夹设置。
- **分栏工作区引擎（自研）**：兼容已保存的布局预设，窗格可拖拽分割并支持标签页；内置资源管理器 / 终端 / 浏览器 / 动画 / 自定义窗口。
- **控制室**：默认自带项目（固定首位、不可删除），项目卡片网格镜像可见绑定项目的宿主状态；状态弹窗显示当前工作室、服务启动状态和当前会话工作区，并使用视口级浮层避免被内容窗遮挡。
- **项目独立挂载**：窗口任务使用项目 ID、窗格 ID 与绑定 ID 对应的专属结果文件；同一文件夹里的新项目仍从空白窗口开始，不自动读取其他项目的旧结果。
- **平台**：Windows 是本轮验证平台，范围见下方兼容说明；macOS 为实验性支持（核心文件路径代码已做跨平台适配，尚未真机端到端验证）。

## 技术底座

- Cordis 插件协议（客户端 bundle + 服务端路由 /api/worktable/*、终端 WebSocket）。
- 界面经 slot 座位协议注入侧边栏与 shell.overlay；对话窗复用宿主会话服务（新版 uiWorkspace.openSession，旧版 sessions.open）。
- 状态监控为宿主会话运行时快照的事件订阅镜像；视图/项目/绑定状态存 localStorage。
- 客户端：TypeScript + React（host externals）+ 原生 CSS；服务端：Node。

## v0.4.0：兼容与验证范围

- DSH 网页端兼容声明仅列 **0.1.1-rc.2 / 0.1.2-rc.1 / 0.2.0-rc.2**，不是对任意新旧版本的保证。
- Windows + 0.2.0-rc.2 网页端已有冷启动、工作台/控制室、新建绑定与短文本回复、关闭回切等验收基础；桌面主要页面与交互已点测，共目录串挂修复获用户确认。最终包经过 98 项源码回归、独立安装与客户端加载门禁；这些检查不等于完整桌面端业务验收。旧版沿用此前页面验收并补定向代码回归，未重跑整套旧版 GUI。
- 实际审批、子代理、自动挂载全链路尚未完成业务验收；macOS 未真机验证。升级后请完整重启 DSH 并刷新页面，仍加载失败需保留完整错误。

## v0.4.0 改动

- 针对 Windows 官方 Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 补上终端连接：从宿主注入的 streamBaseUrl 取得实际 Host 地址，不把 dsh-app://app 当作 WebSocket 主机。普通 HTTP/HTTPS 网页连接保留。
- 更新指令区分 web/desktop profile；桌面安装必须使用该应用自带的 CLI，安装前完整退出，之后由用户手动重新打开。不要把网页端 CLI 当作桌面管理入口。
- 自定义窗口新建对话明确选择「未分组」时，保留项目工作目录但不自动加入宿主工作区；异步默认分组不覆盖用户选择。不移动已经创建的对话。
- 控制室创建的是空对话：新版 DSH 的未分组空对话无法使用原生输入框，因此在这一选择下提示并禁用创建，须由用户选择分组或加入可用的现有对话；不自动改组、不发送激活消息。现有分组未选具体项时也不允许创建。旧宿主未分组分支保留。
- 自动挂载只接收经「自定义」任务登记的项目/窗口结果，握手文件位于项目目录的 `.dsh-worktable/project-<项目 ID>/` 下。换目录、重绑项目、修改布局或手动关闭/替换窗口内容后，旧关联不再自动补挂。
- 同一项目的不同会话只得到和更新各自关联的窗口；同会话追改同名作品可以重新加载。补挂读取失败保留待办，下次打开可重试，成功后才清除。
- 已保存的旧窗口与产物文件保留；根目录旧 `widget-result.json` 不再自动导入。旧对话若需继续自动挂载，请从目标窗口的「自定义 → 发送到会话」发一次任务以建立新关联，随后可在同一对话直接继续修改。不自动清除此前误挂的标签；多个项目主动改写同一实际文件时，文件内容仍可能互相影响。
- 两端共享同一 DSH_HOME 时不必复制会话；项目/布局/媒体和外观设置按浏览器来源保存，不会自动从网页来源同步到桌面来源。不要复制整个浏览器配置或登录状态。

## 权限与外部服务（如实披露）

- **文件访问**：服务端读写工作区与用户指定的目录——文件窗目录列表、MD 编辑保存、项目文件夹 mkdir、站点静态托管、widget 产物读取。除用户当次操作外，插件在加载时、项目状态变化时、已登记窗口任务完成时会自动读取当前关联的 `.dsh-worktable/` 结果文件及其指定产物，并读取宿主提供的工作区数据（workspaces 路由）。不扫描根目录旧 `widget-result.json`；产物路径可来自任务结果，这不是文件系统沙箱。失败返回错误或降级。
- **网络**：① 更新检查向 api.github.com 发只读 GET（无凭据，请求仅含公开仓库名，不携带会话内容）；② 插件与宿主的通信走宿主自身的 API / WebSocket 通道（由宿主管理）；③ 「浏览器」「动画」等网页窗加载用户指定的页面，页面自身可能发起任意网络请求——等同于用户在自己的浏览器中打开这些页面。
- **命令执行**：① 「源代码管理」窗运行 git 只读状态命令；② 「终端」窗经 node-pty 启动交互式 Shell（Windows 下为 PowerShell）——这是用户主动使用的完整终端：终端内执行的任何命令都可能读写文件、联网，行为等同用户本人操作。
- **凭据与环境**：插件代码不专门提取、存储或上传任何 API Key / Token / Cookie；但终端窗把宿主进程的完整环境变量传给子 Shell（其中可能包含敏感信息），终端内命令的行为不受插件约束。插件对 process.env 的读取用于运行参数（数据目录 DSH_HOME、终端默认 Shell SHELL 等），不将其外发。以上声明均有对应源码可查；本说明不是安全保证，高权限能力如实列出，使用风险由用户在自身环境评估。
- **外部依赖与边界**：本适配声明 ws / node-pty 为生产依赖，供终端窗使用；原生依赖安装失败时该窗显示降级提示。不替换、不禁用任何官方插件。本插件不声称解决宿主自身的全部启动问题。

## 安装

### 网页端

方式 A（推荐，无需 Git）——直接安装 GitHub Release 的最新安装包：

    dsh plugin --profile web add "https://github.com/Aisland-SJL/dsh-worktable/releases/latest/download/dsh-worktable.tgz"

方式 B（想改源码用）——克隆仓库后用本地路径注册（`link:` 只接受本地路径，不要带空格）：

    git clone https://github.com/Aisland-SJL/dsh-worktable.git
    dsh plugin --profile web add "link:<克隆出来的 dsh-worktable 仓库目录的绝对路径>/01_content"

两种方式 `add` 都会把 `dsh-worktable` 注册进 profile 的 bundle 列表（写入 `~/.dsh`），装完重启 dsh web、刷新界面生效。

### Windows 官方桌面端

先保存任务，从应用菜单/托盘完整退出（只关窗口不够）；将占位路径替换为实际桌面端安装目录，在 PowerShell 执行，再手动重新打开应用：

    & "<桌面端安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add "https://github.com/Aisland-SJL/dsh-worktable/releases/download/v0.4.0/dsh-worktable-0.4.0.tgz"

不要以不固定版本的 npx 或网页端 CLI 代替桌面端自带 CLI；保留实际 DSH_HOME，勿把测试数据目录覆盖正式数据。新建控制室管理对话时，DSH 0.2 用户请选择分组，或直接绑定可用的现有对话。

## 从源码构建

    cd 01_content
    npm install
    npm run build   # lib/index.js + lib/client.js
    node --check lib/index.js

## 构建注意事项

- **必须在 01_content 目录下构建**：误在仓库根跑会把 lib 写到仓库根，宿主仍加载 01_content/lib 旧 bundle（「改完不生效」假象）。
- 客户端 bundle 保持 window.__ModuleLoader__.load 握手，react/@deepseek-ai/* 全部 external。

## 相关文档

- 项目规则：https://github.com/Aisland-SJL/dsh-worktable/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- 需求与协议：https://github.com/Aisland-SJL/dsh-worktable/blob/main/02_process/PRD.md
- 工作日志：https://github.com/Aisland-SJL/dsh-worktable/tree/main/02_process/worklogs

0.5.0：短剧项目按工作目录恢复持久 dsh 会话，嵌入工作台使用原生聊天；主窗口与浮球共享模型、消息、运行状态与停止。关闭项目恢复独立浮球会话，重新展开保活工作台时恢复项目跟随；需同时更新项目插件 0.3.0、Toonflow 适配补丁和桌面壳。

## 工作室版本与更新

展开工作室后，点击标题工具栏的更新图标，查看所有已启用工作室的版本、检查适配包并升级。此入口使用共享运行时的所有者认证接口；不执行原应用安装器。检查失败可重试，升级进度保留在后台，需要重启时面板会明确提示。现有控制室公告入口保留。

更新弹窗在侧栏自动收起、切换窗口宽度时保留；关闭弹窗不取消宿主管理的安装。

工作室卡片不再显示“未绑定对话”、项目文件夹按钮或布局变更入口；既有项目会话记录继续保留，控制室仍可选择或创建自己的会话。新增工作室时由 AI 询问保存到本地或 GitHub，并在创建后询问是否立即导入。

# dsh-studio-library

[简体中文](README.zh.md)

## Repository

- Repository name: `dsh-studio-library`
- Repository description: Installable DSH control bundle for studio discovery, project containers, service status, sessions and updates. Business studios remain optional.
- Source: `https://github.com/1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-library`

## Features

- `dsh-worktable`: studio list, control room, project container, split workspace and window layout.
- `dsh-studio-projects`: studio registration, page serving, local-service startup and health status, session tools, task expansion and update records.
- Project data and update records are isolated under `DSH_HOME/studio/<studio-id>/`.
- The root package bundles only the two control packages. It does not install business studios or private Live2D/Cubism assets.
- The root manifest declares `dsh.bundle.patch`; `packages/worktable` and `packages/runtime` retain their own package manifests and compiled Host/Client entries.

## Installation

Use the official Desktop plugin manager after fully quitting Desktop, or run the bundled carrier at `resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh.cmd` on Windows. Install the control bundle and then only the business studios you need:

```powershell
& "<Desktop install directory>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add "github:1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-library#v0.1.13"
& "<Desktop install directory>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop list
```

The first command installs `dsh-worktable` and `dsh-studio-projects`; an empty business-studio list is valid. Add a studio from its own README. Verify the installed package with `plugin --profile desktop list`; the manifest must contain `dsh.bundle.patch`, and the package must expose its declared `main` entry and patch file. Restart Desktop after package operations.

Git commits do not update an installed lockfile. Reinstall the exact tag when upgrading. Keep `DSH_HOME/studio/` before removing an older combined package, and install any business studios you want to keep before removing that package.

## Requirements and limits

Use DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` compatible builds and Node.js 22 for source builds. Local applications, OBS, external providers and model assets require their own setup. The public package contains no credentials, private model files or Cubism Core.

## License and sources

The project is MIT licensed. The worktable adaptation retains the upstream notices documented in `SDK-SNAPSHOT.json` and the repository files.

# Product Dev · DeepSeek Harness 插件 把 [Product Dev](https://github.com/ac0033/product-dev) 的产品开发能力装进 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）：从零做产品、给现有项目加功能、修 bug，也能单独推进设计、文档修改、复审、验收或工程套件维护。 通过 `/product-dev` 一个入口，按任务调用随包提供的三组能力： - **产品设计**：需求梳理与 PRD、可操作原型与界面设计、架构与图表。 - **工程实现**：代码探索、方案对比、任务拆解、开发测试与调试。 - **质量与交付**：工程规则与检查闸门、独立审查、PR 与合并、验收与获授权的发布。 各阶段保留产物与验证证据，帮助你减少遗漏、反复解释和交接断层。沿用项目规则与授权边界；实际执行依赖 DSH 提供的终端、浏览器和子代理等工具，见[宿主能力说明](https://github.com/ac0033/product-dev/blob/main/INSTALL.md#宿主能力与工程套件)。 ## 安装 在 DSH 网页版或桌面版打开 **Plugins → Add plugin**，输入包名加版本号，然后点 **Install** 并启用。 ```text dsh-product-dev@0.2.6 ``` 使用 `dsh` 命令行时运行下面的命令。 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-product-dev@0.2.6 ``` ## 使用 在目标项目里开始对话，输入 `/product-dev` 加上你的任务，或直接描述产品想法、功能需求或 bug，由模型加载入口技能。 ## 包里有什么 - `skills/product-dev/`：入口技能和它依赖的全部资料，与其他 Agent 使用的技能包内容相同。 - `lib/index.js`：向 DSH 注册上面这个技能目录。不联网，不读写包目录以外的文件。 你在项目的 `.dsh/skills/`、`.agents/skills/` 或用户目录里放了同名的 `product-dev` 技能时，DSH 优先使用你的那一份。 ## 许可 自有内容以 MIT 发布。包内的第三方内容保留原许可，见 `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`。 # Product Dev **面向 Claude Code、Codex、DeepSeek Harness 及其他支持 Agent Skills 的 Agent 的产品开发插件（0.2.6）。** 把一个产品想法或现有项目的改进目标，逐步变成可核对的设计、代码和交付结果。既能从零做产品、加功能、修 bug，也能只做设计、文档修改、复审、验收或工程套件维护。 内置三组协作能力：**产品设计**（需求梳理、PRD、原型与界面设计、架构与图表）、**工程实现**（代码探索、方案对比、任务拆解、开发测试与调试）、**质量与交付**（检查闸门、独立审查、PR 与合并、验收与获授权的发布）。一个入口按任务选择需要的阶段，沿用项目规则，保留阶段产物与验证证据，帮助你减少遗漏、反复解释和交接断层。各阶段执行依赖[宿主提供的工具](INSTALL.md)。 [快速开始](#快速开始) · [怎么用](#怎么用) · [流程图](#流程图) · [参考与许可](#参考与许可) ## Product Dev 怎么推进一次任务 你从**同一个入口**描述目标、现状和想先做到哪一步。Product Dev 判断需要哪些阶段，沿用项目已有的规则和检查，并把前一阶段确认的结果带进下一阶段。 1. **判断路线。** 先读项目规则、工作区和已有记录。新项目从需求开始，加功能先梳理现有行为，修 bug 先复现。小改动、纯文档和套件维护有各自的短路线。 2. **推进当前阶段。** 例如做新产品时，先确认需求，再做原型走查和架构设计。功能改动进入开发前，先写清验收标准。你也可以只做设计、复审或验收中的一段。 3. **交付可核对的结果。** 每阶段有产物和通过条件，交接时说明已完成、已验证和待确认的事项。接着做以前的任务时，可以直接提供相关分支、PR 或设计文档。 ## 快速开始 ### Claude Code 在终端安装。 ```bash claude plugin install product-dev --marketplace ac0033/skills ``` 较早的版本可以在终端分两步安装。 ```bash claude plugin marketplace add ac0033/skills claude plugin install product-dev@ac0033-skills ``` 打开 Claude Code，在输入框用 `/product-dev:product-dev` 加上你的任务。若在现有会话安装后尚未看到入口，可运行 `/reload-plugins` 或重新启动 Claude Code。 ### Codex 在终端运行下面的命令。需要支持 `codex plugin` 子命令的 Codex CLI。 ```bash codex plugin marketplace add ac0033/skills codex plugin add product-dev@ac0033-skills ``` 在 Codex 桌面端的输入框技能列表选择插件下的 `product-dev`。CLI 中可用 `/skills` 选择 `product-dev:product-dev`。桌面端若仍显示旧列表，可重启后再试。 ### DeepSeek Harness 在网页版或桌面版打开 **Plugins → Add plugin**，输入下面的包名和版本号，安装后启用。 ```text dsh-product-dev@0.2.6 ``` 在输入框用 `/product-dev` 加上你的任务。命令行安装和不装插件的用法见[其他 Agent 安装指南](INSTALL.md#deepseek-harness)。 ### 其他 Agent 安装一个自包含的 `product-dev` 技能包即可。按[其他 Agent 安装指南](INSTALL.md)导入或配置，保留包内资料和脚本。 ### 试一句 > 我想做一个给读书会用的活动报名工具。先梳理参与者和组织者的需求，给出第一版范围和验收标准。等我确认需求后再做原型。
升级已有的 GitHub 市场安装 市场名和插件名保持不变。已有市场安装无需卸载，运行下面的更新命令即可切换到独立仓库的版本。 Claude Code 在终端运行下面的命令，然后重新启动。 ```bash claude plugin marketplace update ac0033-skills claude plugin update product-dev@ac0033-skills ``` Codex 在终端运行下面的命令，然后重新启动桌面端。 ```bash codex plugin marketplace upgrade ac0033-skills codex plugin add product-dev@ac0033-skills ```
## 怎么用 在目标项目目录开始对话。把**目标、已知约束、你希望停下确认的阶段**交给 Product Dev。比如把「加个候补」说成「给活动报名加候补，按报名时间递补。先写清规则和验收标准，等我确认后再实现」。 | 你要做什么 | Product Dev 先做什么 | 你能用什么验收 | | --- | --- | --- | | 从零做一个读书会报名工具 | 建立工程底座，梳理用户、问题与范围 | 需求文档、可操作原型、架构和实施交接 | | 给现有报名页加候补 | 核对报名流程，找出受影响的行为 | 功能契约、边界用例、方案与验证证据 | | 修复取消报名仍占用名额 | 复现问题、定位根因并写失败测试 | 修复与回归测试，可对照修前和修后的结果 | | 改按钮文案或补安装说明 | 判断影响范围，走小改动或纯文档路线 | 对应改动和检查结果 | | 检查工程套件版本 | 对照安装状态和项目差异 | 漂移清单与可审的升级范围 | 询问可行性时，Product Dev 先做只读分析。明确要求实施时，它在授权和项目规则内推进。新项目的工程底座安装会先说明目标目录。生产发布、回滚和破坏性迁移需要对应授权。 **工程套件需要单独安装吗？** Product Dev 已带 `engineering-kit`，可以直接读取规则和调用随附脚本。新项目在获准开工后，把规则、模板和闸门同步进项目。已有项目沿用自己的检查机制，需要引入或升级套件时再按授权同步。 ## 流程图 新项目和加功能各有准备阶段，后续共用同一条交付路线。修 bug 从复现和根因入手，再接到交付后半段。点击任一图可以放大查看。 ### 新项目 · 从想法到实施就绪 先确认需求，再用原型走查验证体验。综合评审通过后配置检查命令，获准实施才进入交付段。 ### 加功能 · 从现状到选定方案 先探索现有代码和行为。改变产品行为时回到设计阶段修订受影响的部分，再确认验收标准与实施方案。 ### 共用交付 · 从任务拆解到发布 图中采用 PR 复审顺序。若项目配置为推送前复审，独立复审在机械闸门通过后、推送前执行。生产发布按任务范围和授权执行。 ### 修 bug · 从复现到回归入库 先判断是实现故障还是需求缺口。确认属于实现故障后，用失败测试固定复现条件，修复并通过相应检查。 ## 参考与许可 - **完整流程**见[入口技能](plugin/skills/product-dev/SKILL.md)和[工程流程说明](plugin/skills/product-dev/references/process.md)，各阶段的工具、验收证据和复审顺序都在这里。 - **组件与版本**见[组件清单](COMPONENTS.md)。可用工具随宿主而异，流程文档说明了按路径读取内部技能和派发子代理的替代方式。 - **测试与许可**见[测试与行为用例](evals/cases.md)、[MIT](LICENSE)和[第三方声明](plugin/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

# dsh-modern-web-guidance

Bring [Modern Web Guidance](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance) — Google Chrome's expert-curated web platform corpus — into [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) as native tools and a skill.

[中文文档](README.zh-CN.md)

```
mwg_search      →  candidate guide ids for "light dismiss dialog"
mwg_retrieve    →  the full guide, code patterns, gotchas, fallbacks
mwg_list        →  every id in the corpus
mwg_legacy_scan →  legacy patterns across a codebase
```

Everything runs **offline**: no API key, no network, no telemetry, ~310 ms per lookup.

---

## Why

Coding agents write legacy web code because the training data is mostly legacy web code: a JavaScript focus trap for a modal that `<dialog>` already handles, a `scroll` listener for a reveal that `animation-timeline: view()` does natively, a polyfill for something that has been Baseline for two years.

Modern Web Guidance is 208 retrievable guides (250 platform features) maintained by the Chrome, Edge, Firefox and MDN teams, each written as *"do it with the platform, here is the fallback you actually need"*, with real Baseline compatibility data. Upstream evaluations (2026-11-08 snapshot, unguided → guided):

| Agent / model | Pass rate |
|---|---|
| antigravity_cli (gemini-4-argon) | 58% → 94% |
| codex_cli (gpt-6.1-sol) | 54% → 82% |
| claude_code (opus-5-5) | 57% → 88% |

This project turns that corpus into first-class DSH capabilities instead of a shell-out per question.

## Install

### Option A — as a DSH plugin (recommended)

**One command** (packs this repo, installs it into your DSH profile, registers the bundle, and copies the skill):

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Aloento/dsh-modern-web-guidance.git
cd dsh-modern-web-guidance
node install.mjs --dry-run   # see exactly what will change
node install.mjs
```

**Or by hand:**

```sh
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web"          # or headless
pnpm add github:Aloento/dsh-modern-web-guidance
```

then append the package to `dsh.profile.bundles` in that profile's `package.json`:

```json
{
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["...", "dsh-modern-web-guidance"] } }
}
```

The package ships its own `cordis.patch.yml`, so no patch has to be written by hand.

### Option B — skill only

Copy [`skill/modern-web-guidance/SKILL.md`](skill/modern-web-guidance/SKILL.md) into a skill root DSH scans:

| Root | Priority |
|---|---|
| `<project>/.dsh/skills` | 100 |
| `<project>/.agents/skills` | 200 |
| `~/.dsh/skills` | 400 |
| `~/.agents/skills` | 500 |

The skill provider watches these directories, so the skill appears without a restart. Without the plugin, the skill shells out to the CLI:

```sh
npx -y modern-web-guidance@latest search "light dismiss dialog"
```

### Option C — any other agent

Upstream ships installers for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Kimi, Grok and friends:

```sh
npx modern-web-guidance@latest install
```

## Usage

### The tools

| Tool | Arguments | Returns |
|---|---|---|
| `mwg_search` | `query` (2–5 words) | `[{ id, description }]`, ranked |
| `mwg_retrieve` | `ids: string[]` | verbatim guide markdown for each id, plus `missing` |
| `mwg_list` | — | every id with a one-line description |
| `mwg_legacy_scan` | `path?`, `full?` | findings grouped by guide, capped at 15; `full: true` adds the raw report |

### Query discipline

The search index is small and intent-shaped; queries that read like prompts do badly.

| You want | Search for |
|---|---|
| a confirmation step before deleting | `confirmation dialog` |
| a drawer that slides in | `navigation drawer` |
| a table usable on a phone | `responsive data table` |
| an animated list reorder | `dynamic sort animation` |
| a page-to-page transition | `view transition between pages` |
| form errors announced correctly | `accessible error announcement` |

- **2–5 words, one capability.** Not `dialog`, not `responsive table dark mode`.
- **No framework, product or file names.** Not `close React settings modal on outside click`.
- **Name the UI primitive, not the business intent.** "confirm first" → `confirmation dialog`.
- If a description matches, call `mwg_retrieve` — do not also call `mwg_list`. If the result is empty, rephrase once with the concrete noun, then proceed without guidance.

### Workflow

1. `mwg_search` before writing any UI, CSS layout/animation or client-side JS.
2. `mwg_retrieve` the matching ids, **plus** the discipline overview that applies (`html`, `css`, `forms`, `accessibility`, `color`, `performance`, `security`).
3. Implement, cross-checking the guide's patterns and fallbacks.
4. End the reply with a `### Modern Web Guidance` section: one line per guide actually applied — the id, a non-obvious choice, and a short verbatim quote of the rule.

### Codebase-wide audits

Only for open-ended modernization, never for "fix this one component". **Always pass the project root** — the tool refuses to scan the home directory by accident:

```sh
npx -y modern-web-guidance@latest legacy-scan . --json
```

Verify each finding against its `keepWhen` / `dropWhen` rubric — the scan covers the ~20% of guides that have deterministic rules.

## Configuration

```yaml
- id: modern-web-guidance
  name: dsh-modern-web-guidance
  config:
    enabled: true          # mount the plugin at all
    injectPrompt: true     # add the mwg_* routing section to the system prompt
    telemetry: false       # false → DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 for the CLI
    cwd: ''                # CLI working directory; where .mwgrc is looked up
    cliPath: ''            # override the resolved CLI entry (env MWG_CLI works too)
    timeoutMs: 60000       # per CLI invocation
    cacheTtlMs: 300000     # search/list/retrieve cache; 0 disables
    maxRetrieveChars: 120000
```

### Experimental features

Origin Trial and volatile (single-engine, shipped in the last three months) guides are hidden from `retrieve` by default. Opt in per project with a `.mwgrc` at the project root:

```json
{ "allowOriginTrials": true, "allowVolatileFeatures": true }
```

## How it works

```
DSH agent
  │  mwg_search / mwg_retrieve / mwg_legacy_scan
  ▼
lib/index.js      cordis plugin — defineTool registrations + prompt section
  │
  ▼
lib/bridge.js     spawns `node <modern-web-guidance>/skills/.../modern-web.mjs`
  │               TTL cache · output-spool recovery · error normalisation
  ▼
modern-web-guidance (npm, 17 MB, self-contained)
  offline BM25 + embedding search over 208 guides
```

Two upstream behaviours are absorbed rather than exposed:

- **Large output is spooled.** Above ~9.5 KB the CLI writes a temp file and prints only a pointer; the bridge reads it, returns the content and deletes the file.
- **Exit codes lie.** An unknown id exits non-zero while still emitting the guides it found. Usable output wins: only a run with no guide section at all raises.

Telemetry from the upstream CLI (install counts, agent name, retrieved ids, search terms — never raw prompts) is disabled by default via `DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1`.

## Requirements

- Node.js ≥ 22
- DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2 < 0.4.0-0`
- Disk: ~9 MB for the guide corpus

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| Tools never appear | Check the bundle is in `dsh.profile.bundles` and the package is in the profile's `node_modules`; restart the harness |
| `modern-web-guidance CLI not found` | `pnpm add modern-web-guidance` in the profile, or set `cliPath` / `MWG_CLI` |
| `mwg_retrieve` returns `missing` | The id was not real — re-run `mwg_search`; never invent ids |
| Empty `mwg_search` | Rephrase once with the concrete UI noun (`dialog`, `popover`, `table`, `form`) |
| Skill shows, tools do not | That is Option B — expected; the skill drives the CLI through bash |
| `pnpm` fails during install | On Windows the installer already bypasses `pnpm.cmd`; if pnpm lives elsewhere, set `PNPM_JS` |

## Uninstall

```sh
node uninstall.mjs            # drops this repo's bundle entry, package and skill copy
node uninstall.mjs --dry-run  # preview
```

A `SKILL.md` you edited after installing is left in place. Nothing else on disk is touched.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test          # 14 offline checks against a mock cordis context
```

Layout:

```
lib/index.js               plugin entry: config, tools, prompt section
lib/bridge.js              CLI process bridge, spool handling, error cleaning
skill/modern-web-guidance  SKILL.md for the skill-only path
cordis.patch.yml           bundle patch (inserts the plugin row)
scripts/pnpm.mjs           cross-platform pnpm invocation
install.mjs / uninstall.mjs
test/verify.mjs            offline checks
```

## Attribution and license

- **This repository** — MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).
- **Upstream guides** (`modern-web-guidance`) — code under Apache-2.0, guide content under [CC-BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), partly derived from MDN, W3C, WHATWG and IETF material. See [NOTICE](NOTICE).
- **Not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.** This is an independent integration; the corpus, the CLI and the skill text originate in `GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance`.
- `SKILL.md` here is an adapted copy of the upstream skill, adjusted for DSH conventions (Windows runner, offline CLI path, model-facing tool names).

# dsh-explorer-open

在 Windows 资源管理器的右键菜单里加一条 **「通过 dsh 打开」**：点一下就在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 里打开这个文件夹（没有工作区就新建），并开一个新会话。

Win11 的**新式简洁菜单**和**旧式完整菜单**里都有这一条，都带图标。

- 仓库：<https://github.com/ame-code/dsh-explorer-open>
- npm：`dsh-explorer-open`

![在文件上右键选「通过 dsh 打开」，新会话的输入框里已经带着该文件的 @引用](docs/demo.png)

## 功能

| 在哪儿右键 | 打开的文件夹 | 放进新会话的草稿 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 文件夹空白处 | 当前文件夹 | 无 |
| 文件夹图标上 | 这个文件夹 | 无 |
| 任意文件上 | 文件所在的文件夹 | `@文件名` 引用（工作区之外的路径不引用） |

- 每次都**新建会话**并切过去；工作区按完整路径复用，不会重复创建。
- dsh 没开时会先把它拉起来，请求排队等页面连上再执行。
- 插件停用/卸载时会**自己拆掉菜单**（旧式注册表键 + Win11 新式 MSIX 包），不留垃圾。

## 状态

当前 **0.1.x**：功能可用，但接口（`/api/plugins/...` 路径、`~/.dsh/dsh-explorer-open/` 状态目录、`DSH_EXPLORER_OPEN_*` 环境变量）和安装方式都还可能变，破坏性改动不保证向后兼容。

原生组件（`win11/`）有独立的版本号，见 `native/version.txt`；JS 侧版本见 `package.json`。

## 兼容性

| dsh 版本 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| 0.2.2-rc.1 | 实测通过：右键菜单 → 新会话 → 文件 `@引用` 全流程 |
| 0.2.2-rc.2 | 源码契约核对通过，尚未真机回归 |

对 0.2.2-rc.2 的核对范围（rc.2 与 rc.1 逐文件比对，均无破坏性改动）：

- `uiWorkspace.openWorkspace / openSession / startSession` 与 `StartSessionOptions`
- `workspaces.create({ path })`、`sessions.create({ workspaceId, cwd })`、`sessions.binding(id)`
- `conversation.input.requestDraftInitialization(binding, options)` 与 `DraftInitializationOptions`（rc.2 只新增了 `insertQuote`）
- `webServer.register` 的 `WebResourceRoute`（`kind / path / resource`，只答 GET/HEAD）
- 客户端清单 `dsh.bundle.patch`、`dsh.client.platform/inject/immediately`、`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`

插件没有声明 `engines.dsh`，所以 rc.2 新增的插件版本门禁（`engines.dsh` 或 `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer 不满足时拒绝安装/启用）不会拦它；同时也意味着旧版本 dsh 上不会被提前拦住。

## 安装

### 从 npm 安装（推荐）

在 dsh 的插件设置里安装 `dsh-explorer-open`，或让 agent 执行安装（bundle 安装入口接受 npm 包名）。

首次启用时会自动装 Win11 新式菜单所需的 MSIX 包。因为是自签证书，包里没有受信的根，Windows 会拒绝安装并给出：

```
Deployment failed with HRESULT: 0x800B0109
```

这时以管理员身份运行一次插件目录下的 `native/trust-cert.bat`（把自签证书 `dsh-open-with.cer` 导入 `LocalMachine\TrustedPeople`），然后重启 dsh 即可。只需要做一次。

> 只想要旧式菜单、不想动证书：设环境变量 `DSH_EXPLORER_OPEN_NO_MSIX=1` 再启动 dsh，插件就不会去装 MSIX 包。

### 从源码/本地目录安装

```powershell
# 仓库本身就是插件包（package.json 在根目录）
plugin_manager install_bundle E:\work\tools\dsh-open-with
```

改过代码后要重启 dsh 才会重新加载宿主侧插件；客户端 bundle 需要刷新页面。

## 工作原理

```
资源管理器右键
   ├─ 旧式菜单：HKCU\Software\Classes\{Directory\Background, Directory, *}\shell\OpenWithDsh
   │     └─ powershell -File launch.ps1 "%V"   （无窗口，写入待办后退出）
   └─ 新式菜单：MSIX 包身份 + 原生 IExplorerCommand
         └─ 同一个 launch.ps1
                ↓
   %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-explorer-open\pending.json   {folder, file?, token, at}
                ↓  宿主侧插件每 300ms 扫描
   GET /api/plugins/dsh-explorer-open/request          （带 x-dsh-explorer-open 头）
                ↓  页面侧插件每 1s 轮询
   workspaces.create → sessions.create → uiWorkspace.openSession
                ↓  文件右键时
   conversation.input.requestDraftInitialization(binding, { prompt: '@文件', clearPreviousDraft: true })
```

- 启动器用 PowerShell 5.1 写 UTF-8（**无 BOM**）、先写临时文件再改名，页面不会读到半个 JSON。
- `/api/...` 路由要求自定义请求头，跨站页面带不上它（会先触发预检），因此别的网页没法领走排队中的请求。
- dsh 可执行文件位置由插件写进 `config.json`，启动器按 config → `DSH_EXPLORER_OPEN_EXE` → 常见安装路径的顺序查找。

## win11/ 原生组件

Win11 新式菜单不接受「注册表 + exe」的旧式扩展，必须是一个**有包身份、已签名、且 DLL 内嵌了 msix 身份清单**的 COM 组件。`win11/` 就是这个组件：

```
win11/
├─ src/dsh_open_with.cpp   IExplorerCommand 实现（GetTitle/GetIcon/GetState/Invoke）
├─ src/stub.cpp           满足清单的占位 exe（Windows.FullTrustApplication 入口，永不被启动）
├─ src/test-host.cpp      不经过资源管理器的自测宿主
├─ src/msix.manifest      DLL 内嵌的 msix 身份（publisher/packageName/applicationId）
├─ src/msix.rc            把上面那份清单编进 PE 资源
├─ assets/dsh.ico         菜单图标
├─ package/AppxManifest.xml  MSIX 清单：comServer + fileExplorerContextMenus
├─ build.sh               构建 → 签名 → 打包 → 同步到 ../native/
├─ install-msix.ps1 / uninstall-msix.ps1
└─ trust-cert.ps1 / trust-cert.bat   把自签证书导入受信存储
```

重新构建（需要 MinGW-w64、`windres`、Windows SDK BuildTools 的 `makeappx`/`signtool`，以及 `Cert:\CurrentUser\My` 里的 `CN=DshOpenWith` 证书）：

```bash
cd win11
bash build.sh
```

`build.sh` 会把签名好的 `DshOpenWith.msix`、`dsh-open-with.cer` 和 `version.txt` 复制到 `../native/`，插件启用时按 `version.txt` 决定要不要重装。

### 踩过的坑（都已在代码里修掉）

1. **清单里的 GUID 不能带花括号**，否则 `Add-AppxPackage` 报 `0x80080204 / 0xC00CE169`。
2. **DLL 必须内嵌 msix 身份清单**，否则资源管理器根本不会加载这个 COM 类（表现为"装好了但菜单里没有"）。
3. DLL 必须 `-static` 链接：包目录里没有 `libwinpthread-1.dll`。
4. `GetState` 不要依赖选中项解析结果：新式菜单取「文件夹空白处」时 `IShellItemArray` 是空的，返回 `ECS_HIDDEN` 会把菜单项藏起来。恒返回 `ECS_ENABLED`，路径解析放到 `Invoke`。
5. AppX 代理进程里 `GetModuleFileNameW(NULL)` 返回的是代理进程的路径，图标要按 `DllMain` 保存的 `hinst` 取自身目录。
6. 自签证书必须进 `LocalMachine\TrustedPeople`；`CurrentUser\Root` / `CurrentUser\TrustedPeople` 都不够。

## 开发

```bash
# 宿主侧：注册表、待办扫描、HTTP 路由、启用/停用清理
# USERPROFILE 指向一个空目录（要用 Windows 路径写法），DSH_EXPLORER_OPEN_TEST_HOME=1 是防误跑的开关
USERPROFILE='E:\tmp\dsh-explorer-open-home' DSH_EXPLORER_OPEN_TEST_HOME=1 \
DSH_EXPLORER_OPEN_REG_BASE='HKCU\Software\Classes\__dsh_explorer_open_test' \
DSH_EXPLORER_OPEN_NO_MSIX=1 node test/host-test.mjs

# 页面侧：调用顺序、参数、@引用拼装、失败回退
node test/client-test.mjs
```

两个脚本都用假的 ctx / fetch，不会碰真实的菜单和 MSIX 包。

- `HANDOFF.md`：开发笔记（决策记录、踩坑、待办），中文。
- `win11/build/` 与 `.probe/` 是构建产物和本地临时目录，不纳入版本库。

## 排查

点菜单后如果只把 dsh 窗口调到前面、没有打开工作区，先看两个地方：

1. `~/.dsh/dsh-explorer-open/trace.log` —— 宿主记录页面何时取走请求（`poll served=...`）、页面回报的处理结果（`ack stage=start|ok|fail`）。
   - 只有 `poll served` 没有 `ack`：页面里的客户端没跑起来，刷新页面（Ctrl+R）或重启 dsh。
   - `ack stage=fail`：带的是失败原因，多半是工作区/会话服务报错。
   - 连 `poll served` 都没有：请求没到宿主，检查 `~/.dsh/dsh-explorer-open/pending.json` 是否被写出来
     （经典菜单走注册表里的 `launch.ps1`；Win11 新式菜单走 MSIX 里的 `DshOpenWith.dll`，两者都指向这个目录）。
2. `LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-explorer-open-command.log` —— 只有设了 `DSH_EXPLORER_OPEN_DEBUG=1` 时，原生组件才写这个日志。

## 已知限制

- 只在 Windows 上工作（注册表 + MSIX + 资源管理器）。
- `*` 键会让这一条出现在**所有**文件类型上，包括没有关联程序的。
- 以管理员权限运行的资源管理器不会显示用户级（HKCU）菜单项。
- 新式菜单需要证书受信；分发第三方时应该用正式代码签名证书，而不是自签。

## License

# dsh-ui-alt

在保持原版 UI 大风格不变的情况下，进行减小圆角、紧凑化、秩序化、整洁化改进。使 UI 视觉更加冷静、专业、高效。多数改动可在设置中单独开关。

插件由 CSS 覆盖加少量 DOM 注入组成，所有改动都可以在 设置 →「UI 改进」里逐项开关；关掉开关即恢复原版外观。

## 功能

**外观**

| 开关 | 默认 | 效果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 隐藏左上角 Logo | 关 | 隐藏侧栏顶部的 Logo |
| Windows 默认微软雅黑字体 | 关 | 将 Windows 端默认字体改为微软雅黑。微软雅黑带有 hinting，使文字在显示设置低于 200% 缩放比例下，更加锐利清晰。若手动设置了字体，或使用 macOS 端，则不受影响 |

**布局**

| 开关 | 默认 | 效果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 减小圆角与间距 | 开 | 缩小全局圆角、缩小侧栏部分字号、收紧间距，使界面更高效 |
| 会话标题栏紧凑化 | 开 | 紧凑化会话标题栏，使会话内容可视范围更大 |
| 统一新会话按钮样式 | 开 | 新会话按钮样式改为与导航按钮一致 |
| 折叠侧栏导航功能 | 开 | 折叠侧栏导航，点击箭头展开收起 |
| 弱化工作区名称 | 开 | 工作区名称弱化，使工作区和会话更易区分 |
| 会话前圆点 | 开 | 会话前显示一个圆点 |
| 移除工作区与会话悬停提示 | 开 | 悬停在侧栏工作区、会话上时不再显示详情卡片，使滚动更流畅 |
| 隐藏会话悬停多余按钮 | 开 | 悬停会话行时只保留菜单和置顶，其余按钮（含插件添加的）隐藏；若有插件按钮未在右键菜单中，可关闭 |
| 设置面板全屏 | 开 | 使用非窗口化的设置页面 |

**性能与用量信息**

| 开关 | 默认 | 效果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 优化布局 | 开 | 优化输入框下方性能与用量布局，将数据分布在左右两侧平衡视觉重心 |
| 显示余额 | 开 | 在输入框下方性能与用量中显示账户余额 |
| 余额警告阈值 | 3 | 余额低于此值将变为红色，最小为 0 |

另有一些不挂开关的固定样式：设置导航列宽 220px、归档会话标题画删除线、选择题选中项的序号反色高亮、浅色主题下选中会话背景加强、工作区行悬停时保持文件夹图标。

## 安装

在 DeepSeek Harness 里用插件管理器安装本仓库目录：

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle  target=<本仓库绝对路径>
```

安装后刷新 Web 页面，设置里会出现「UI 改进」一栏，侧栏设置导航同时出现对应图标。

插件以 `link` 方式登记到 profile，因此本仓库目录需要保留在原位；移动或删除目录前请先卸载。

## 设置项与持久化

开关状态存放在 `localStorage` 的 `dsh-ui-alt:prefs:v1` 键下，写成 `html[data-dcc-*]` 属性驱动样式：

| 属性 | 取值 |
| --- | --- |
| `data-dcc-radius` | `on` / `off` |
| `data-dcc-new` | `on` / `off` |
| `data-dcc-nav` | `collapsed` / `expanded` |
| `data-dcc-dim` | `on` / `off` |
| `data-dcc-logo` | `hidden` / `shown` |
| `data-dcc-dot` | `on` / `off` |
| `data-dcc-font` | `on` / `off` |
| `data-dcc-full` | `on` / `off` |
| `data-dcc-hover` | `on` / `off` |
| `data-dcc-row-buttons` | `on` / `off` |
| `data-dcc-compact-header` | `on` / `off` |
| `data-dcc-stats` | `on` / `off` |
| `data-dcc-balance` | `on` / `off` |

## 目录结构

```text
dsh-ui-alt/
├── package.json      ← 名称/版本/exports/files/dsh 清单
├── cordis.patch.yml  ← 插入行：id/name = dsh-ui-alt
├── index.js          ← Host 半（空 apply，无 Host 逻辑）
├── client.js         ← 全部功能：CSS 覆盖 + 少量 DOM 注入
├── locale/
│   ├── zh.json       ← 插件管理器标题/描述
│   └── en.json
└── icon.svg          ← 设置页导航图标 + 插件图标
```

`client.js` 内部：

- 预置数据：`STORAGE_KEY`、`DEFAULTS`、`readPrefs()` / `applyPrefs()` / `savePrefs()`。
- 一大段 `css` 字符串，全部按 `html[data-dcc-*]` 条件生效；设置页自身样式用 `.dcc-*` 前缀。
- 三个 DOM 注入函数，各带一个监听 `body` 的 `MutationObserver`（350–400ms 防抖）兜底宿主重渲染：
  - `installNewSessionRow()`：克隆宿主的「新会话」按钮成导航行，点击转发给原按钮。
  - `installNavToggle()`：导航下方插入展开/收起箭头，点击切换 `data-dcc-nav` 并写回偏好。
  - `installSettingsBackButton()`：设置面板左上角插入返回按钮，点击触发原关闭按钮。
- 设置页组件：`Section`（标题 + 说明 + 开关行）、`Switch`、`Row`、`SectionIcon`。

## 开发

```bash
node --check client.js
node --check index.js
node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json','utf8'))"
```

修改 `client.js` 后需要重新安装插件并刷新页面，新代码才会被加载：

```text
plugin_manager remove_bundle  target=dsh-ui-alt
plugin_manager install_bundle target=<本仓库绝对路径>
```

## 依赖的宿主实现

下面这些宿主细节升级后可能失效，失效时表现为对应的那一条样式不再生效，不会报错：

- CSS module 类名后缀：`_sessionRow`、`_projectRow`、`_title`、`_dialog_`、`_menu_`、`_navCell`、`_navTitle`、`_close`、`_optionRow` 等。
- 设置面板 DOM：`_overlay` / `_panel` / `_navTitle` / `_navList` / `_navCell` / `_header` / `_close`。
- Windows 变量：`--dsh-windows-titlebar-height`、`--dsh-windows-content-radius`。
- 主题 token：`--dsw-alias-*`、`--dsw-radius-*`、`--dsw-corner-shape`。
- 第三方兼容：仅当安装了 `@michengai/dsh-archive-manager` 时，`dsham_starSlot` / `dsham_rowStar` 规则才命中，用于圆点与收藏星标的避让。

## 已知限制

- 克隆出来的新会话行没有原按钮的 Tooltip 与快捷键提示（点击行为已转发，功能正常）。
- 设置返回按钮依赖宿主的 `_navTitle` / `_close` 类名。
- 「统一新会话按钮」关闭时，折叠导航的首位是隐藏的克隆行，计数偏移一项；显示效果正常。
- 侧栏悬停与滚动的开销主要来自宿主自身的样式重算（实测渲染占 60% 以上，脚本仅 4%），插件已在事件层拦掉了悬停卡片，但无法消除宿主这一层的成本。
- 余额取自宿主账户接口，未登录或接口不可用时该项不显示；余额每分钟刷新一次。
- 余额警告阈值只接受非负数值，负数或非法输入会被归零。

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE)

![preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/btspoony/dsh-keys-manager/main/docs/preview.png)

# DSH Keys Manager

[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-keys-manager)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-keys-manager)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-339933)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-keys-manager)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%5E0.2.2--rc.1-0969DA)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm)

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns one provider API key into a managed pool.
It extends the Models page rather than replacing it: providers, models, and the
model picker stay where they are; only the API-key source moves behind the
manager.

## What it does

**Pool and routing**

- Several keys per provider, each with an alias and a health state.
- One key pinned to a session, round-robin for new sessions; a failing request
  is retried on its key, then moved to another key.
- Exponential cooldown recovery, capped at seven days.

**Accounts and sign-in**

- Seven pi-ai OAuth providers can join the pool as an account instead of a
  pasted key.
- Two more sign in through the plugin's own bundled clients: Kilo and Z.AI
  Coding Plan.
- Seven companion transport routes for providers the vendored pi-ai cannot
  speak: Cursor, Devin, the two Google routes, Factory Droid, and the two
  GitLab Duo routes.

**Interface**

- A search-driven Keys Manager page on the plugin's own detail page.
- A "managed by Keys Manager" badge inside the existing Models provider cards.
- Extra built-in providers installed as ordinary `llm-pi-ai` routes — 35 of
  them, listed under [Provider coverage](#provider-coverage).

## Quick start

### Install

In the Desktop or Web app, open **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter `dsh-keys-manager`,
click **Install**, then **Enable now**. This installs the same published package
as the CLI path, already carrying its built bundle.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-keys-manager
```

One install yields both bundles, `dsh-keys-manager` and `llm-omp-transports`;
enable both — the manager owns credentials and routing, the transport the seven
routes' wire protocols. Refresh the Web page afterwards for the browser half.

<details>
<summary>Install from a local checkout</summary>

```sh
git clone https://github.com/btspoony/dsh-keys-manager
cd dsh-keys-manager
pnpm i
dsh plugin --profile web link .
```

`add` installs the published tarball with its built `lib/` and client bundle;
`link .` builds them via `prepare` during `pnpm i`, as does `prepack` when packing.

</details>

## Use it

### Take over a provider and add keys

1. Search for a provider. Open **Plugins → Keys Manager → View** (`Plugins →
   密钥管理 → 查看` in the Chinese locale); the manager renders on the plugin's
   detail page. Existing DSH providers appear first; the plugin also ships the
   curated extra catalog described under [Provider coverage](#provider-coverage).
2. Adopt a provider. For an existing provider the manager imports the
   currently resolved credential, writes a broker reference into the provider
   profile, and leaves the original key in the credential store so release can
   restore it.
3. Add more keys with an alias. Every key is stored in the Harness credential
   store under its own reference; the manager state document never contains a
   key literal.
4. Manage a key from the three-dot menu: rename, pause/resume, delete. A key
   row shows status, last use, and the recovery time while cooling.
5. Tune retry count (1–3), base cooldown, and recovery grace in the settings
   card.

### Accounts and sign-in

Providers that ship a native OAuth sign-in offer two ways to join the pool:
**Add key** stores a static API key, while **Add account** runs the provider's
OAuth sign-in flow and stores the result as an account row in the same pool.
Nine routes join as an **account**: seven through pi-ai's own flows, `kilo` and
`zai` through the plugin's bundled clients (device code, pasted `zcode://`
redirect), which mint a **static** credential renewed only by **Sign in again**.

| Route group | How it joins | Refresh / renew |
|---|---|---|
| 9 OAuth accounts | **Add account** — seven pi-ai flows, two plugin clients | provider-managed for the seven; **Sign in again** for the two static credentials |
| 7 transport routes | **Transport accounts** — one grant per route | see [Transport routes](#transport-routes) |

**API keys form the selection ring** — sticky sessions, round-robin, retry
failover and cooldowns operate across the provider's keys — while **one
projected OAuth grant serves its provider**, and an account row's counters
reflect only that account's own successes and failures. Per-account ranking is
future work. When the projected grant fails, the account cools down and the
pool falls back to its keys, or stops serving on an OAuth-only route until a
manual re-login.

**`muse-code` needs no transport or account row of its own**: the vendored pi-ai
`meta` route (`openai-responses` on `https://api.meta.ai/v1`) serves it, the
agreement check was static, and the first live call is a manual smoke check per
[Known limits](docs/known-limits.md).

### Transport routes

Providers the vendored pi-ai cannot speak are served by the companion
`dsh-llm-omp-transports` component:

- One grant per route, at `llm-omp-transports/<route>` — no key pool and no
  per-account rotation. Sign-in happens in the **Transport accounts** section of
  the Keys Manager page.
- Models are generated from the pinned `@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog@18.18.8` table when
  the transport is built, and the clients are unofficial: read the
  [transports package docs](packages/llm-omp/README.md) and its
  [known limits](packages/llm-omp/docs/known-limits.md) before relying on them.

| Route | Sign-in | Refresh | Model rows |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cursor` | browser page + poll | on the credential seam | 123 |
| `devin` | paste the landed callback URL | none — sign in again | 2 |
| `google-gemini-cli` | loopback `8085` + paste fallback | on the credential seam | 7 |
| `google-antigravity` | loopback `51121` + paste fallback | on the credential seam | 22 |
| `factory-droid` | WorkOS device code (URL + user code) | one refresh in a 60 s window, keeps `orgId`/`region` | 77 |
| `gitlab-duo` | PKCE loopback `localhost:8080/callback`, no port fallback, paste fallback | one refresh in a 60 s window | 16 |
| `gitlab-duo-agent` | paste the `vscode://` URL | one refresh, echoes the `vscode` redirect | 1 |

<details>
<summary>Per-route notes</summary>

- **Cursor** — streams text and reasoning and hands tool calls to DSH's tool
  loop; images are refused with a typed error. The client presents Cursor's
  vendor-internal OAuth identity.
- **Devin** — no refresh: a static bearer whose expiry is derived from the token
  (JWT `exp` minus five minutes, else one year), and without a readable expiry
  the row shows `active` with a blank countdown column.
- **Google routes** — both share one generated `lib/omp/google.mjs` artifact yet
  keep separate grants, account rows and catalogs. The grant is
  `{access, refresh, expires, projectId, email?}`; sign-in resolves the Cloud
  project the route bills, and a `legacy-tier` or paid account whose project
  cannot be discovered fails `AUTH_FAILED` until `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT` (or
  `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID`) is set.
- **Factory Droid** — four wires behind one proxy, chosen by model id inside the
  artifact; rows carry no base URL and the account's residency
  (`orgId`/`region`) survives refresh.
- **GitLab Duo pair** — `gitlab-duo`'s direct-access token cache is keyed on the
  GitLab token, so a rotated token misses it; `gitlab-duo-agent` re-seeds a
  workflow per request and replays the transcript rather than resuming a socket.

</details>

### Selection and failure policy

| Mechanism | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Sticky session | The first request of a session selects a key and binds it for that session/provider pair. Later requests reuse it. |
| Round robin | A new session advances the provider cursor and takes the next healthy key. |
| Retry | A failing request is retried on the same key `retryCount` times. Request-shaped failures such as `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED` and cancellation never cool a key. |
| Switch | After the retry budget is spent, the failing key is marked cooling, and the session is rebound to another healthy key. When no alternate key exists, the manager delegates to the composition's normal retry/fallback policy. |
| Cooldown | The first failure cools a key for `baseCooldownMs`. A failure while cooling, or within `recoveryGraceMs` after recovery, doubles the next cooldown; a long healthy gap resets the escalation. The hard cap is seven days. |
| Recovery | The key is automatically selectable again when its cooldown expires; no manual reset is required. |

## Configuration & data

Manager metadata lives at:

```text
$DSH_HOME/keys-manager/state.json
```

with owner-only permissions. It contains aliases, credential references,
health counters, session bindings, and provider adoption facts. API key
literals live only in the Harness credential store; an account row follows the
same rule behind its `grantRef`, with only non-sensitive metadata (email,
account id, expiry) in the state. The file is written atomically through a
temporary file and a rename.

Each managed provider profile points its `apiKeyEnv` at a broker reference
such as `KEYSMGR_ZAI_CODING_CN_3FA2C1`. The Host credential layer answers that
reference per request with the session's selected key. The Models page sees
the profile as configured; writing directly to the broker reference is
refused with a pointer to the manager.

<details>
<summary>OAuth2 extension point</summary>

The state shape already distinguishes `kind: "api-key"` from `kind: "oauth"`
and keeps a nullable `oauth` object beside the credential reference. A future
account flow can add records under `keys-manager/<provider>/<key>` without
rewriting existing rows. Providers whose only authentication is OAuth are
reported as unsupported in this version rather than being treated as API-key
providers.

</details>

## Provider coverage

Four groups, one pool:

- **DSH built-in** — routes from the shipped DSH pi-ai catalog. The set follows
  your installed DSH version, so the Models page is the authoritative list; four
  of them are outside single-key pooling (below).
- **Plugin extra built-in** — 35 routes this plugin adds as ordinary
  `llm-pi-ai` routes.
- **OAuth accounts** — 9 routes that join as an account instead of a pasted key:
  seven use pi-ai's own flows, `kilo` and `zai` are signed in by the plugin's
  bundled clients.
- **Transport routes** — 7 routes the vendored pi-ai cannot speak, served by
  `dsh-llm-omp-transports`.

**Transport routes — 7** — `cursor`, `devin`, `google-gemini-cli`,
`google-antigravity`, `factory-droid`, `gitlab-duo`, `gitlab-duo-agent`; sign-in,

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-llm-omp-transports

A DeepSeek Harness LLM transport component for providers whose wire protocols
the vendored `llm-pi-ai` does not speak. It is published from this repository
as `dsh-llm-omp-transports` and installed as a dependency of
`dsh-keys-manager`: installing the Keys Manager plugin brings this component,
and the plugin page lists both bundle components
(`dsh-keys-manager` and `llm-omp-transports`).

| Fact | Value |
|---|---|
| npm package | `dsh-llm-omp-transports` |
| Plugin id | `llm-omp-transports` |
| Routes | `cursor`, `devin`, `google-gemini-cli`, `google-antigravity`, `factory-droid`, `gitlab-duo`, `gitlab-duo-agent` (the seam is provider-generic) |
| Credential scope | `llm-omp-transports/<provider>` — one record per route (`cursor`, `devin`, `google-gemini-cli`, `google-antigravity`, `factory-droid`, `gitlab-duo`, `gitlab-duo-agent`) |
| Runtime | Node 24 (the bundle imports Node builtins only) |
| License | MIT |

The plugin registers its own route on the DSH `llm` seam, so it depends on no
upstream DSH change. `@oh-my-pi/pi-ai` and `@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog` are used at
**build time only**: the build inlines the pinned omp transports into one ESM
artifact per route (`lib/omp/cursor.mjs`, `lib/omp/devin.mjs`), plus one shared
artifact for the two Google routes (`lib/omp/google.mjs`), and the published
package imports nothing from `@oh-my-pi/*` or `bun:*` at runtime.

## Cursor support status

- **Text streaming** — yes. Assistant text and usage are projected onto DSH's
  `StreamChunk` stream.
- **Reasoning streaming** — yes, with the catalog's effort routing. The
  selected effort becomes the routed wire model id; an effort the model does
  not advertise is refused with `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`.
- **Tool-call handoff** — yes, through DSH's tool loop. Cursor's server drives
  execution over its exec channel, so the transport runs in external-executor
  mode: an unhandled MCP call is emitted as an unresolved tool call and
  answered with a handoff, DSH runs the tool, and the next request replays the
  result from history. The adapter never executes a tool itself.
- **Sign-in and refresh** — yes. The package registers the
  `llm-omp-transports/cursor` authorization flow (a browser login page plus a
  poll, no loopback callback and no device code) and refreshes an expiring
  grant under the credential store's per-key lock. The Keys Manager Web page's
  **Transport accounts** section is the surface that starts the flow.
- **Models** — from the pinned catalog: the Cursor slice of
  `@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog@18.18.8` (123 rows) is generated into
  `src/catalog/cursor.ts` and served without a network call.
- **Route** — `cursor`, declared configurable so the Models page has a profile
  entry for it.
- **Images** — not yet. The route advertises text-only input and refuses image
  blocks with `CONTENT_UNSUPPORTED`; see [known limits](docs/known-limits.md).

## Devin support status

- **Text streaming** — yes. Assistant text and reasoning are projected onto
  DSH's `StreamChunk` stream, with the per-turn usage the chat frames report.
- **Reasoning streaming** — yes as content; no reasoning-effort selector. Both
  pinned rows advertise no efforts, and a request that selects one is refused
  with `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`.
- **Tool-call handoff** — yes, native to DSH's tool loop. The transport emits
  the call, finishes the turn `toolUse`, and DSH executes it; the result is
  replayed from history on the next request. Unlike Cursor, no call is
  transport-resolved, so nothing is filtered from the handoff.
- **Sign-in** — yes, by pasting the callback. The pinned omp login is a
  declarative `oauth-code` rule whose loopback listener is Bun-only; this
  package registers the `llm-omp-transports/devin` flow, opens the authorize
  page, and asks for the address the browser landed on (or just the code).
  There is **no refresh** (`refresh "none"`): an expired grant demands a new
  sign-in.
- **Models** — from the pinned catalog: the Devin slice of
  `@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog@18.18.8` (2 rows: `swe-1-6`, `swe-1-6-fast`) is
  generated into `src/catalog/devin.ts` and served without a network call.
- **Route** — `devin`, declared configurable so the Models page has a
  `providers.devin` profile with an allow-list.
- **Images** — not yet, same as Cursor: text-only input, image blocks refused
  with `CONTENT_UNSUPPORTED`.

## Google support status

Two routes share one artifact: `google-gemini-cli` (Google's Gemini CLI client)
and `google-antigravity` (the Antigravity hub client). The bundled
`streamGoogleGeminiCli` dispatches on `model.provider`, so the route is a data
difference — separate OAuth client, catalogs, hosts, scopes and credential
records — not a second code path.

- **Text streaming** — yes, including reasoning parts and usage.
- **Reasoning streaming** — yes, with each row's own effort ladder: the
  budget-mode rows send `thinkingConfig.thinkingBudget`, the Gemini-3+ rows send
  `thinkingLevel`. A row with `requiresEffort` refuses a turn that selects no
  effort (`UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`), exactly as omp does.
- **Tool-call handoff** — yes, native to DSH's tool loop, like Devin: the
  transport emits the call and finishes the turn `toolUse`. Antigravity's
  default tool mode (`VALIDATED`) is sent on every request that declares tools.
- **Sign-in** — yes, with a real loopback listener on `127.0.0.1`:
  `:8085/oauth2callback` for Gemini CLI and `:51121/oauth-callback` for
  Antigravity, as the pinned rules declare. The browser redirect completes the
  flow automatically; if the port is taken the listener falls back to an
  ephemeral port and the authorize page names the port it actually bound. The
  full address the browser landed on (or `code#state`) can also be pasted; a
  pasted code without the state is refused, because that is exactly the shape a
  forged callback would have. Anything the listener does not recognise — a
  foreign `state`, an `error=`, a missing code — is answered `400` and dropped
  without ending the attempt, so a stray request cannot kill the sign-in. The
  listener closes on the matching callback, on an aborted attempt and **on a
  timeout** (five minutes, `GoogleFlowOptions.waitMs` for tests): an expired wait
  fails with `AUTH_FAILED` and commits nothing.
- **Refresh** — yes. The resolver refreshes once, under the credential store's
  per-key lock, when `expires - 60 s <= now`, keeps the `projectId` and an
  un-rotated `refresh_token`, and reports a dead sign-in as `REAUTH_REQUIRED`.
- **Credential record** — `llm-omp-transports/<route>` with
  `{access, refresh, expires, projectId, email?}`. The adapter hands the
  transport the structured JSON envelope (`token`, `projectId`, `refreshToken`,
  `expiresAt`, `email`) that omp parses.
- **Project discovery** — sign-in finishes with the Cloud Code Assist project:
  `loadCodeAssist` → (tier onboarding `onboardUser` + LRO poll, or the required
  `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT` / `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID` variable for a
  `legacy-tier`/paid account). Antigravity additionally checks free-tier
  eligibility and bounds onboarding at 30 s.
- **Models** — generated from the pinned `@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog@18.18.8`: 7 rows
  for `google-gemini-cli`, 22 for `google-antigravity`, served without a network
  call.
- **Routes** — both declared configurable, so the Models page has
  `providers.google-gemini-cli` and `providers.google-antigravity` allow-lists.
- **Images** — not yet, same posture as the other routes: text-only input, image
  blocks refused with `CONTENT_UNSUPPORTED`. omp's Antigravity image path
  decodes through `Bun.Image`, which does not exist under Node, so that path is
  dead here by construction; the projection never reaches it.

## Factory Droid support status

- **Text streaming** — yes, including reasoning parts and usage.
- **Wires** — four protocols behind one proxy, selected by the model **id** inside the
  artifact (Anthropic Messages for Claude rows, the Responses API for GPT/Grok, Chat
  Completions for Kimi/GLM/DeepSeek, native generateContent for Gemini). The plugin never
  chooses a backend, and rows carry no base URL: the transport derives the per-wire proxy
  path and honours the account's residency host.
- **Sign-in** — WorkOS **device code**: the flow shows the verification page and the user
  code, the human approves in the browser, and the poll completes the grant. No listener and
  no paste; the attempt's own signal is the only cancellation channel.
- **Refresh** — yes: one refresh inside a 60 s window under the credential store's per-key
  lock, keeping the account scope (`orgId`/`region`/`inferenceRegion`), which the adapter
  forwards to the transport as `oauthIdentity` so a EU account gets its own host.
- **Catalog** — 77 rows from the KDL registry seed (`models.json` has no factory-droid key),
  zero-cost Factory credits.
- **Build** — the graph needs three **entry-scoped build substitutions** (empty catalog data,
  a lean provider registry, a lean env-key map) to fit its ceiling; see the limits below.

## GitLab Duo support status

Two routes over GitLab's AI surface, both registered from one catalog pin.

**`gitlab-duo` (proxy).** The transport POSTs for a direct-access token, substitutes the
row's `upstreamModelId` and delegates to one of three generic wire transports
(Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Responses, Chat Completions) through GitLab's gateway.

- 16 catalog rows carrying the upstream id, the wire and the full compat object.
- **Sign-in** — OAuth code with PKCE, the loopback listener on `localhost:8080/callback`
  **without port fallback** (the redirect is registered exactly) and a paste prompt as the
  fallback path. `GITLAB_CLIENT_ID`/`GITLAB_REDIRECT_URI` support a custom OAuth app, and a
  `GITLAB_TOKEN` personal access token works as the bearer.
- **Refresh** — one refresh inside a 60 s window; the artifact's direct-access token cache
  is keyed on the GitLab token, so a rotated token misses it by construction.

**`gitlab-duo-agent` (Duo Workflow).** One WebSocket workflow per turn; GitLab's
server-side loop yields at every tool call, so DSH's native tool loop executes them and the
next turn replays the result through the goal transcript.

- 1 static row (`claude_sonnet_4_6_vertex`, 1M context); live model discovery is not
  implemented, and the server may pin another model on its side.
- **Sign-in** — paste-only: the browser hands the code to VS Code, so the human pastes the
  full `vscode://gitlab.gitlab-workflow/authentication?code=…&state=…` URL. The state is
  mandatory (no listener means it is the only thing tying the paste to the attempt), and a
  refresh echoes the `vscode` redirect.
- **Session state** — a fresh map per request (plan A6): each turn re-seeds a workflow and
  replays the transcript instead of resuming another turn's socket. Correct but heavier;
  sticky resume is a follow-up.

## Hard constraints

- **Pinned, build-time-only omp.** `@oh-my-pi/pi-ai` and `@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog`
  are pinned to `18.18.8` and declared as devDependencies. No runtime package
  may import them: `tests/build.test.ts` checks that every static import of the
  shipped artifact is a Node builtin.
- **Node 24 load.** The artifact is imported through a plain Node ESM loader
  with no Bun global present, and must expose `streamCursor`. The Bun and
  `@oh-my-pi/pi-utils` surface the bundled graph reaches is covered by the
  shims in `scripts/omp-shim/`; a missing shim symbol or a new shim category
  fails the build.
- **Drift gate.** `scripts/omp-manifest.json` records the pinned versions, the
  measured artifact, the shim surface and the hashes of every source the
  transport depends on, plus the shim symbols the esbuild graph actually
  reaches. `tests/build.test.ts` re-checks all of it, and CI asserts the
  committed manifest is unchanged after a build, so an omp bump that changes
  the contract shows up as a reviewable manifest diff before it can reach a
  request.
- **Generated catalogs.** The model tables (`cursor`, `devin`,
  `google-gemini-cli`, `google-antigravity`) are generated from the pinned
  catalog and are not hand-edited. An omp or catalog bump requires
  `pnpm -C packages/llm-omp run generate:catalog`.

## Limits and risks

- **Unofficial Cursor client.** The transport reuses Cursor's vendor-internal
  OAuth client id and announces a released CLI build through the
  `x-cursor-client-version` / `x-cursor-client-type` request identity. The MIT
  license covers the code, not the service, so relying on this client carries a
  terms-of-service (ToS) risk. If Cursor gates non-IDE clients (a `401`/`403`
  on `Run` with a valid account), this transport stops until the product
  decision recorded as stop condition **S4**.
- **Real endpoints unverified.** The login, poll, refresh and agent endpoint
  shapes are ported from the pinned omp sources; this repository's tests replay
  recorded fixtures and never call Cursor, so live behavior is unverified until
  it is exercised against a real account.
- **In-process checkpoint cache.** Per-conversation checkpoints live in a
  module-level, in-process LRU (128 conversations) inside the bundled omp
  transport. Nothing is persisted: an evicted or lost checkpoint rebuilds from
  the request history, exactly like the first request after a restart, and a
  multi-step tool turn must replay its history.
- **Image input is advertised as text-only.** Forwarding is future work; until
  it lands the projection refuses non-text blocks instead of silently dropping
  them. 100 of the pinned catalog's 123 rows claim image support but are
  advertised text-only.
- **Tool handoff uses DSH's external-executor mode.** A turn that needs a tool
  stops at the handoff; the result is only replayed on the follow-up request.
  Tool declarations travel as MCP definitions, and `toolHistory` is accepted
  but cannot be replayed (the active tool set is the projection).
- **Colliding DSH tools are aliased, not dropped.** The transport keeps
  Cursor's own `read`/`bash`/`write`/`delete`/`ls`/`grep`/`todo` names off the
  MCP advertisement, so a DSH tool with one of those names is advertised as
  `dsh_<name>`; the event stream restores the DSH name on the tool call, while
  history replay keeps the advertised alias so the follow-up request stays
  consistent. The seven `dsh_<native>` names are reserved: a DSH tool that
  already carries one is refused with `TOOL_ALIAS_COLLISION`, which fails the
  whole request and requires renaming the tool. Any other tool name travels
  unchanged. Cursor-native exec frames (`read`, `shell`, `write`, `delete`,
  `grep`, `ls`, `diagnostics`, streamed edits) are still answered by the
  transport with `Tool not available` and are **not** executed by DSH (live
  reachability unverified).
- **Advisory request knobs are ignored.** Cursor's agent protocol has no field
  for an output cap, sampling temperature, stop sequences or an auxiliary-call
  purpose; DSH's `maxTokens`, `temperature`, `stop` and `purpose` never reach
  the wire, and Cursor applies the catalog output limit server-side.
- **Unofficial Devin client.** The transport presents the released Devin CLI
  identity (`ideName: "devin-cli"`, `ideType: "chisel"`, `ideVersion:
  "3000.11.205"`) and a `connect-go` client header the omp sources copy from the
  CLI. Same posture as Cursor's S4: a first live turn rejected with `401`/`403`
  stops the route until a product decision, never a retry under another
  identity.
- **Attribution deviates on one call.** The Devin chat request must keep the
  transport's own `connect-go` client header — the backend gates on it. The
  header-less `GetUserJwt` handshake has no identity of its own, so the adapter
  fills DSH's attribution `user-agent` only where a header is absent. Cursor's
  requests keep full attribution.
- **Devin has no refresh.** The pinned rule declares `refresh "none"`, so the
  record is a static bearer with a derived `expires` (JWT `exp` minus five
  minutes, else one year). An expired or corrupt record is `REAUTH_REQUIRED`,
  not renewed. Because the omp loopback listener is Bun-only and the browser
  half is untestable offline, the flow is paste-only for now; a bare pasted
  code skips the state check (the page is the only place the state could
  travel).

- **The Factory Droid artifact strips the registry-derived env-key map.** Its graph would
  otherwise pull omp's whole provider registry, so one entry-scoped substitution keeps the
  pin's `getEnvApiKey` but not the `PROVIDER_REGISTRY` half — the computed Foundry/ADC/Bedrock
  resolvers are gone. That path is unreachable for this route (every request carries the
  stored WorkOS token), and a catalog-declared plain variable (`OPENAI_API_KEY`, …) still
  resolves. The install id is per-process rather than persisted for the same reason: the
  transport must not write to a user's home.
- **Unofficial Google clients.** The Google routes reuse the OAuth clients and
  client identities the pinned omp rules capture — Gemini CLI
  (`GeminiCLI/0.46.0/...` plus `Client-Metadata`) and Antigravity
  (`antigravity/hub/<version> ...`). Same posture as the Cursor and Devin
  routes: the MIT license covers the code, not the service, and a first live
  turn rejected with `401`/`403` on a valid token stops the route until a
  product decision (stop condition **S4**) — never a retry under another
  identity.
- **Antigravity version lookup.** Before the first Antigravity request the
  artifact reads the client version from the public update manifest (D11),
  because the backend gates newer models on that version. A failed lookup is
  silent and falls back to the pinned `2.26.0` for ten minutes; an explicit
  `PI_AI_ANTIGRAVITY_VERSION` skips the lookup. That is the only outbound
  request the routes make besides the vendor API itself.
- **Google sign-in waits at most five minutes.** The loopback listener is
  bounded by a wait budget (five minutes by default): a browser that never
  returns fails the attempt with `AUTH_FAILED`, closes the socket and commits
  nothing. An aborted attempt is reported as a cancellation, not a failure.
  When the configured port is taken, the fallback is an ephemeral port; a host
  that can bind neither fails the sign-in rather than silently dropping the
  browser half (pasting still works only while the listener is up).
- **Google attribution deviates on both routes.** The Cloud Code Assist wire
  sets a vendor `user-agent` that the backend gates on, so DSH's attribution
  `user-agent` is filled only where a request left the header absent — the same
  fill-absent wrapper the Devin handshake uses.
- **Real Google endpoints unverified.** The wire suite drives the bundled
  transport end to end over a stubbed `fetch` (URL, envelope, headers, SSE,
  in-band errors, Antigravity failover and the version manifest), but it never
  calls Google. A first live sign-in and turn is a manual smoke check, not a
  claim of server acceptance.

## Develop and test

```sh
pnpm -C packages/llm-omp typecheck
pnpm -C packages/llm-omp build
pnpm -C packages/llm-omp test
pnpm -C packages/llm-omp run generate:catalog
```

`build` bundles the pinned omp graphs from `scripts/omp-entry.ts`,
`scripts/omp-entry-devin.ts` and `scripts/omp-entry-google.ts` into
`lib/omp/cursor.mjs`, `lib/omp/devin.mjs` and `lib/omp/google.mjs` and rewrites
`scripts/omp-manifest.json`; run it before `test` after a pin or shim change. CI runs the same sequence and then fails if
the committed manifest drifted.

The install proof lives at the repository root and needs `pnpm` and `dsh` on
`PATH`:

```sh
node scripts/verify-install.mjs
```

It packs both packages, installs the root tarball into a fresh DSH profile,
and asserts that the composed profile carries both loader rows
(`dsh-keys-manager` and `llm-omp-transports`). It does not exercise the
plugin-manager UI or any provider network behavior.

## Release

This package is released from the same release PR and carries the same version
as `dsh-keys-manager`; the root `CHANGELOG.md` and its generated sections cover
the root package only. A release-prep run writes one version to both
`package.json` files, and the Release workflow publishes both and pushes the
`dsh-llm-omp-transports@<version>` tag.
The root [release docs](../../docs/release.md) describe the full flow.

Package documentation is English-only; the root `README.md` /
`README.zh-CN.md` and the root `docs/*.zh-CN.md` files carry the bilingual
plugin surface.

## License

Released under the [MIT License](../../LICENSE).

- **The GitLab Duo proxy is the largest artifact.** It bundles three production wire
  transports plus GitLab's gateway shim, which is why its ceiling is the package's highest;
  the same entry-scoped substitutions keep the model catalog and the builtin registry out.
- **Duo's Anthropic inner wire is not proven end-to-end in the suite.** The transport retries
  a refused turn on that wire, so the test bounds the turn and asserts the request; the SSE
  decode itself is exercised through the OpenAI wires and by the sibling routes' suites.
- **`gitlab-duo-agent`'s checkpoint loop is not proven in-suite.** The suite proves the REST
  bootstrap, the bearer, and that no socket opens before a workflow exists, plus the adapter's
  tool handoff contract; the fake-socket round trip (start frame, checkpoint deltas,
  `runMCPTool` reseed, stall restart) needs a scripted nine-call bootstrap and a checkpoint
  corpus, and is the recorded follow-up. The first live turn is a manual smoke item.

## Deferred

`factory-droid` **ships** in this component: the 17 MB graph that kept it out of the earlier
plan (issue `I-000253`) is built through the accepted, drift-gated build substitutions, so the
issue is resolved by that work rather than bypassed. What remains deferred is narrower:

- **Sticky GitLab Duo workflow resume.** Each turn re-seeds a workflow and replays the goal
  transcript instead of resuming the previous socket; correct but heavier, and the in-memory
  session map that would resume it is a follow-up.
- **The live transcript proof for `gitlab-duo-agent`.** The fake-socket checkpoint round trip
  (start frame, checkpoint deltas, `runMCPTool` reseed, stall restart) needs a scripted REST
  bootstrap plus a checkpoint corpus, and the first live turn is a manual smoke item.
- **The Duo Anthropic inner wire's SSE decode** — the wire retries a refused turn, so its
  suite bounds the turn and asserts the request instead of the stream.

# DSH Keys Manager

[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-keys-manager)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-keys-manager)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-339933)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-keys-manager)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%5E0.2.2--rc.1-0969DA)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm)

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns one provider API key into a managed pool.
It extends the Models page rather than replacing it: providers, models, and the
model picker stay where they are; only the API-key source moves behind the
manager.

## What it does

**Pool and routing**

- Several keys per provider, each with an alias and a health state.
- One key pinned to a session, round-robin for new sessions; a failing request
  is retried on its key, then moved to another key.
- Exponential cooldown recovery, capped at seven days.

**Accounts and sign-in**

- Seven pi-ai OAuth providers can join the pool as an account instead of a
  pasted key.
- Two more sign in through the plugin's own bundled clients: Kilo and Z.AI
  Coding Plan.
- Seven companion transport routes for providers the vendored pi-ai cannot
  speak: Cursor, Devin, the two Google routes, Factory Droid, and the two
  GitLab Duo routes.

**Interface**

- A search-driven Keys Manager page on the plugin's own detail page.
- A "managed by Keys Manager" badge inside the existing Models provider cards.
- Extra built-in providers installed as ordinary `llm-pi-ai` routes — 35 of
  them, listed under [Provider coverage](#provider-coverage).

## Quick start

### Install

In the Desktop or Web app, open **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter `dsh-keys-manager`,
click **Install**, then **Enable now**. This installs the same published package
as the CLI path, already carrying its built bundle.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-keys-manager
```

One install yields both bundles, `dsh-keys-manager` and `llm-omp-transports`;
enable both — the manager owns credentials and routing, the transport the seven
routes' wire protocols. Refresh the Web page afterwards for the browser half.

<details>
<summary>Install from a local checkout</summary>

```sh
git clone https://github.com/btspoony/dsh-keys-manager
cd dsh-keys-manager
pnpm i
dsh plugin --profile web link .
```

`add` installs the published tarball with its built `lib/` and client bundle;
`link .` builds them via `prepare` during `pnpm i`, as does `prepack` when packing.

</details>

## Use it

### Take over a provider and add keys

1. Search for a provider. Open **Plugins → Keys Manager → View** (`Plugins →
   密钥管理 → 查看` in the Chinese locale); the manager renders on the plugin's
   detail page. Existing DSH providers appear first; the plugin also ships the
   curated extra catalog described under [Provider coverage](#provider-coverage).
2. Adopt a provider. For an existing provider the manager imports the
   currently resolved credential, writes a broker reference into the provider
   profile, and leaves the original key in the credential store so release can
   restore it.
3. Add more keys with an alias. Every key is stored in the Harness credential
   store under its own reference; the manager state document never contains a
   key literal.
4. Manage a key from the three-dot menu: rename, pause/resume, delete. A key
   row shows status, last use, and the recovery time while cooling.
5. Tune retry count (1–3), base cooldown, and recovery grace in the settings
   card.

### Accounts and sign-in

Providers that ship a native OAuth sign-in offer two ways to join the pool:
**Add key** stores a static API key, while **Add account** runs the provider's
OAuth sign-in flow and stores the result as an account row in the same pool.
Nine routes join as an **account**: seven through pi-ai's own flows, `kilo` and
`zai` through the plugin's bundled clients (device code, pasted `zcode://`
redirect), which mint a **static** credential renewed only by **Sign in again**.

| Route group | How it joins | Refresh / renew |
|---|---|---|
| 9 OAuth accounts | **Add account** — seven pi-ai flows, two plugin clients | provider-managed for the seven; **Sign in again** for the two static credentials |
| 7 transport routes | **Transport accounts** — one grant per route | see [Transport routes](#transport-routes) |

**API keys form the selection ring** — sticky sessions, round-robin, retry
failover and cooldowns operate across the provider's keys — while **one
projected OAuth grant serves its provider**, and an account row's counters
reflect only that account's own successes and failures. Per-account ranking is
future work. When the projected grant fails, the account cools down and the
pool falls back to its keys, or stops serving on an OAuth-only route until a
manual re-login.

**`muse-code` needs no transport or account row of its own**: the vendored pi-ai
`meta` route (`openai-responses` on `https://api.meta.ai/v1`) serves it, the
agreement check was static, and the first live call is a manual smoke check per
[Known limits](docs/known-limits.md).

### Transport routes

Providers the vendored pi-ai cannot speak are served by the companion
`dsh-llm-omp-transports` component:

- One grant per route, at `llm-omp-transports/<route>` — no key pool and no
  per-account rotation. Sign-in happens in the **Transport accounts** section of
  the Keys Manager page.
- Models are generated from the pinned `@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog@18.18.8` table when
  the transport is built, and the clients are unofficial: read the
  [transports package docs](packages/llm-omp/README.md) and its
  [known limits](packages/llm-omp/docs/known-limits.md) before relying on them.

| Route | Sign-in | Refresh | Model rows |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cursor` | browser page + poll | on the credential seam | 123 |
| `devin` | paste the landed callback URL | none — sign in again | 2 |
| `google-gemini-cli` | loopback `8085` + paste fallback | on the credential seam | 7 |
| `google-antigravity` | loopback `51121` + paste fallback | on the credential seam | 22 |
| `factory-droid` | WorkOS device code (URL + user code) | one refresh in a 60 s window, keeps `orgId`/`region` | 77 |
| `gitlab-duo` | PKCE loopback `localhost:8080/callback`, no port fallback, paste fallback | one refresh in a 60 s window | 16 |
| `gitlab-duo-agent` | paste the `vscode://` URL | one refresh, echoes the `vscode` redirect | 1 |

<details>
<summary>Per-route notes</summary>

- **Cursor** — streams text and reasoning and hands tool calls to DSH's tool
  loop; images are refused with a typed error. The client presents Cursor's
  vendor-internal OAuth identity.
- **Devin** — no refresh: a static bearer whose expiry is derived from the token
  (JWT `exp` minus five minutes, else one year), and without a readable expiry
  the row shows `active` with a blank countdown column.
- **Google routes** — both share one generated `lib/omp/google.mjs` artifact yet
  keep separate grants, account rows and catalogs. The grant is
  `{access, refresh, expires, projectId, email?}`; sign-in resolves the Cloud
  project the route bills, and a `legacy-tier` or paid account whose project
  cannot be discovered fails `AUTH_FAILED`

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# 小爪同伴

给 DeepSeek Harness 做的 macOS 和 Windows 桌宠。它会在桌面巡游，随任务切换动作。点击猫可以查看余额、峰谷倒计时、最近任务的 Token 和预估费用。

## 在 macOS 安装

支持 macOS 13 或更新版本，包括 Apple 芯片和 Intel Mac。至少打开过一次 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 后，用 `⌘Q` 退出，再在终端运行以下命令。

```sh
'/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh' plugin --profile desktop add 'https://github.com/buzhidaojiaoshenmehao/dsh-cat-pet/releases/download/v0.4.0/dsh-cat-pet-0.4.0.tgz'
```

重新打开 Harness 后，小爪同伴会随插件启动。点击菜单栏的脚印可以打开面板、召回、隐藏或退出桌宠。Harness 安装在其他位置时，将命令里的应用路径改成实际位置。

## 在 Windows 安装

1. 解压发布包。双击 `preview.cmd` 可以先体验巡游、追光标、逗猫和任务动作。预览面板标记为演示，使用示例余额和任务。
2. 启动过一次官方 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 后，从系统托盘彻底退出 Harness。
3. 在解压目录打开 PowerShell，运行下面的命令，再重新打开 Harness。桌宠会随插件启动。

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add .\dsh-cat-pet-0.4.0.tgz
```

如果终端找不到 `dsh`，在 Harness 的应用菜单启用“管理 dsh 命令”，或直接调用 Harness 安装目录中的 `resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd`，传入相同参数。

已在官方 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.2-rc.1` 上验证安装。同一个 `.tgz` 包含 macOS 通用程序、Windows x64 和 ARM64 程序及素材，安装时无需编译。Windows ARM64 上运行 x64 版 Harness 时，插件随宿主选择 x64 桌宠。Windows 10/11 需要支持每显示器 DPI 感知的版本。

## 逗猫与账单

| 操作 | 效果 |
| --- | --- |
| 光标移动到猫附近 | 猫追上来，靠近时抬爪，在光标位置留下短暂的扑爪提示 |
| 光标停在猫身上 | 抬爪、冒爱心，停久一点会翻肚皮 |
| 左键点猫 | 打开面板，查看余额、峰谷倒计时、最近任务与设置 |
| 按住拖动 | 把猫搬到桌面上的其他位置 |
| 拖动面板里的大小滑杆 | 以 1% 为步长在 50%–180% 之间实时缩放 |
| 打开音效 | 点击猫、摸猫或扑到光标时会听到一声猫叫，任务完成仍会播放提示音 |
| 右键点猫，或打开 macOS 菜单栏或 Windows 托盘里的脚印 | 摸摸猫、让猫伸懒腰、切换音效和巡游、叫到当前屏幕、隐藏或退出 |

走路会缓慢起步和停下，步态由 12 帧连成循环。猫在静坐时会眨眼、呼吸，偶尔伸懒腰。思考时猫会侧头，执行工具时会蹲下或踱步，闲置时会趴睡。任务结束会短暂弹出 Token 和预估金额。并行任务分别结算，最近一单可以在余额面板里回看。音效默认关闭，开启时会试听一声猫叫。 [音频来源](assets/AUDIO.md)

峰谷倒计时每秒更新，显示当前高峰或空闲时段、剩余时间和下一次切换的北京时间。计费和倒计时共用同一份 2026–2027 年日历，覆盖午间、周末和节假日。日历用完时面板会提示更新。macOS 将大小和音效写入系统偏好设置，Windows 保存在 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-cat-pet\settings.ini`。

余额优先使用当前或最近一单的 DeepSeek 路由。登录账号模式读取 Harness 自带的充值和赠送钱包，API Key 模式使用 Harness 已配置的凭证查询 DeepSeek 官方接口。尚无任务时优先查询已登录账号。自定义端点的余额由对应服务商提供。点“刷新”可重新查询，查询失败会显示原因。

用量按一轮 Harness 任务内模型请求的实际用量累计。输入包含缓存命中与未命中，推理 Token 已包含在输出里。同一轮内已经结束的本地子任务会计入父任务，父任务先结束时会标记部分统计，之后结束的子任务另行显示。第三方模型或缺少用量时只展示能核实的统计。金额按每次调用的模型、缓存及北京时间峰谷价估算，使用 2026-11-12 核对的人民币和美元价格及 2026–2027 年节假日安排。Search / Fetch 等按次收费不在 Token 估算内。

点击余额前无需额外输入 API Key。凭证留在 Harness，桌宠仅通过父子进程管道接收状态、用量和余额。鼠标互动读取位置，猫做扑爪动画。光标的移动始终由你控制。

## 卸载

在 Harness 的插件管理中移除“小爪同伴”。也可以完全退出 Harness 后，使用它自带的 `dsh` 运行下列命令。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-cat-pet
```

## 验证

已构建 macOS 通用程序和 Windows x64、ARM64 程序。多屏路径、计费、余额响应和任务归集测试通过。在官方 Harness `0.2.2-rc.1` 的隔离配置中安装插件，用模拟模型测试真实工具和任务事件。

在 Apple 芯片 Mac 上实测了桌宠窗口、面板、大小滑杆和音效开关。余额与用量通过模拟数据验证。Windows 可先用 `preview.cmd` 检查桌宠窗口、鼠标动作和托盘菜单。

## 开发

`src/` 是 Harness 插件，`macos/` 和 `windows/` 分别使用 AppKit 和 Win32，`native/` 提供共享的路径、计费和协议代码。`bin/` 存放预编译程序和透明素材。完整发布包在装有 Xcode 或 Command Line Tools、Zig 0.14.1、`zip` 和 `unzip` 的 Mac 上构建。

```sh
node scripts/prepare-sprites.mjs
npm test
npm run build:macos
npm run build:windows
node scripts/package.mjs
```

切分透明图集需要 `ffmpeg` 和 `ffprobe`。修改走路图集并重新切分后，可用装有 `opencv-python-headless` 的 Python 运行 `python scripts/prepare-walk.py` 重新生成中间帧。构建时可用 `PAW_ZIG` 指定 Zig 路径。构建后可以从项目目录运行 `open bin/macos/LittlePaw.app` 体验演示。图集和提示词见 [动作素材说明](assets/PROMPTS.md)。
